scope: Read actual helper, protocol XML, and local official compositor source. Native output-to-cursor mapping still requires actual IPC observation during authorized execution. No GUI or input execution performed.
helperContract: The move command passes integer x/y and argv width/height to motion_absolute unchanged, followed by frame and display roundtrip.
protocolContract: x ranges from zero to x_extent, y from zero to y_extent.
compositorContract: VirtualPointer.cpp checks nonzero extents and emits x/xExtent,y/yExtent normalized absolute coordinates.
fixtureContract: Use exact physical-size/scale logical extents, send motion alone, retain actual hyprctl cursorpos observations before any button and refuse unless within 0.5 logical pixel.
